Question: Which drugs are indicated for both asthma and chronic obstructive pulmonary disease?

response.cypher: MATCH (dr:Drug)-[:INDICATION]->(d1:Disease), (dr)-[:INDICATION]->(d2:Disease) WHERE toLower(d1.name) = 'asthma' AND toLower(d2.name) = 'chronic obstructive pulmonary disease' RETURN DISTINCT dr.name AS drug_name, dr.id AS drug_id LIMIT 50
